jobs.description: JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way . Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. What this job involves: This is a single-site leadership role with full accountability for the performance, resilience, and long-term value of a major international banking client’s flagship corporate headquarters. As the Owner’s Representative on the ground, you are the ultimate accountable person for everything that happens within the building—operationally, financially, and strategically. You will operate with a landlord mindset, treating the asset as if it were your own investment. Your mandate is to protect and enhance its value through proactive lifecycle management, rigorous risk governance, and strategic capital planning—moving decisively beyond reactive facilities management toward Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Net Operating Income (NOI) optimization. You are the eyes, ears, and voice of ownership on site: ensuring statutory compliance, safeguarding business continuity, managing cyber-physical risks in critical systems, and driving decisions that align physical asset performance with the banks physical asset strategy on the balance sheet. What your day-to-day will look like: On-Site Asset Stewardship As the primary point of accountability for the site headquarters, you own the health and performance of all base building elements: structure, façade, roof, common areas, and critical MEP infrastructure (HVAC, power/UPS, fire & life safety, vertical transport, BMS/OT networks). Ensure all systems are engineered for reliability, resilience, and efficiency—not just functionality. Validate condition assessments and performance data to reflect real-world asset deterioration. Enforce compliance with building codes, fire safety, and environmental regulations—exceeding minimum standards to achieve industry best practice. Risk Ownership & Operational Resilience You are the primary risk owner for the site. Foster a “see it, own it, fix it” culture where risks are surfaced early and managed decisively. Lead development and testing of Business Continuity Plans (BCP) tailored to the building’s criticality. Act as gatekeeper for Operational Technology (OT) security, ensuring BMS and IoT devices meet cyber-hygiene standards to prevent breaches. Drive the Risk Acceptance Process: document unresolved risks, quantify business impact (e.g., “Chiller #2 failure = loss of cooling to trading floor”), and secure formal client sign-off on mitigation timelines. Has total authority to stop works of all partners that may result in business impact to occupiers, risk to banks reputation, or risk to the built asset. Has the ability and awareness to foster a speak up culture. Lifecycle Planning & Capital Strategy Develop and execute a 10–15-year Capital Expenditure (CapEx) roadmap grounded in predictive analytics and asset performance data. Replace “run-to-fail” with proactive replacement cycles for major building systems. Oversee defect liability management and commissioning handovers from capital projects to ensure “soft landings” and protect the bank from post-completion liabilities. Value Creation & Investment Mindset Consider the building as an income-generating asset. Identify and execute initiatives that enhance market relevance, sustainability, and valuation. Champion value-add opportunities: energy retrofits, ESG upgrades, space repositioning, or technology integration. Partner with finance teams to model ROI, cap rate impact, and NOI (NOI=Total Revenue−Operating Expenses) uplift from capital investments. Maintain awareness of Hong Kong office market dynamics to help benchmark the asset against market trends and performance to help identify areas of strategy change for the building. Financial Oversight & Executive Reporting Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting for the site—with a focus on asset health, not just cost control. Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to bank leadership, reporting on NOI, valuation trends, liquidity, and project ROI. Provide technical and financial intelligence to support regional strategy, renewals, or disposition decisions. Required Skills and Experience: Min. 10 to 15 years in property, asset, or corporate real estate management, with hands-on experience managing a single, mission-critical headquarters or Grade A tower. Proven track record in base building operations, lifecycle planning, and capital project oversight for complex assets. Direct experience acting as the landlord representative or owner’s agent. Good understanding of MEP systems, critical environments, and BMS/OT architecture. Grasps ISO 55000 asset management principles. Fluency in real estate finance: NOI, Cap Rates, NPV, TCO modelling, and balance sheet impacts. Demonstrated ability to manage operational resilience, cyber-physical risk, and statutory assurance in high-profile buildings. A natural integrator: able to influence engineers, vendors, finance teams, and C-suite stakeholders. Diplomatic yet decisive—comfortable making tough calls when asset integrity or business continuity is at stake. Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders – natural coach and leader – helping teams through ambiguity and able to cut through challenging operational structures. Awareness of when change is needed, can create such structure, challenge the ‘norm’ and improve every day. - Constantly looking for new experiments and ways to improve performance, with the ability to make data driven decisions and recommendations.

You will lead programs and initiatives that deepen community engagement, build strong influencer relationships, and deliver impactful marketing communications that inspire, delight, and inform our players.

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

• Develop and execute community engagement programs and initiatives tailored to DACH market League players
• Build and maintain strong relationships with local creators, influencers, and community leaders to amplify key moments and campaigns
• Partner with Publishing and Esports teams to integrate community and influencer activations into marketing and esports initiatives
• Create and deliver player messages that are locally relevant and aligned with our regional product strategy
• Champion player perspectives, needs, and feedback to internal teams by monitoring sentiment, gathering insights, and surfacing recommendations
• Identify and deliver player-facing opportunities and experiences that connect the community with League of Legends’ key beats and events
• Coordinate with global and regional partners to ensure consistent messaging and impactful campaign delivery
• Track, analyze, and report on community and influencer campaign impact to optimize future efforts

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years in community management, influencer relations, or marketing communications in gaming, entertainment, or related industries
• Proven ability to engage and grow player communities through targeted programs and activations
• Experience managing influencer and creator partnerships, from sourcing to campaign execution
• Strong communication skills, fluent in German and English at a professional level
• Ability to adapt global messaging to resonate with local audiences
• Deep understanding of League of Legends, its esports ecosystem, the MOBA landscape, and League player culture in the DACH market.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience integrating community and influencer programs with broader product and esports initiatives
• Familiarity with publishing campaign planning and integration
• Track record of delivering activations that drive measurable player engagement, particularly at a community and influencer level
• Comfortable working in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritizes the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this is the role for you!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

Join CD PROJEKT RED and help shape the future of QA Engineering across our projects and Shared Development Services initiatives. We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to help build and scale technical quality solutions, automation frameworks and testing infrastructure used across multiple Unreal Engine projects.

You will be part of the QA Engineering team within Shared Development Services (SDS) - a shared technical group focused on improving quality, testability and development workflows through automation, reusable tooling and standardized testing platforms.

While the priority for this role will initially be supporting the development of Witcher 4 this is not a project-dedicated position. Your work will contribute to long-term cross-project QA Engineering solutions and shared technical capabilities used across the studio.

This is an opportunity to join at the early stages of a highly innovative game and play a key role in shaping scalable QA engineering practices from the ground up. You will work closely with development teams to build and maintain automated testing solutions, testing environments and shared technical tooling supporting multiple teams and gameplay systems.

Responsibilities:

•

Collaborate with Engineering, Tech Art, Art, QA, DevOps, and central development services teams to support integration and deployment of automated testing solutions, shared tooling, and testing environments across projects.

•

Design, develop, maintain, and extend automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure for Unreal Engine systems and reusable gameplay modules.

•

Support migration, integration, and validation of shared automation solutions between different projects and development environments.

•

Investigate, debug, and resolve technical issues related to automation, integrations, testing environments, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure.

•

Participate in the code review process and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across QA automation codebases.

•

Work closely with development teams to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability of shared systems.

•

Proactively monitor and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid identification and resolution of build and test failures.

•

4+ years of experience in QA Engineering, test automation, or software testing, preferably within the gaming industry.

•

C++ experience, especially within Unreal Engine environments.

•

Knowledge of working with automated testing, tooling, and testing infrastructure in Unreal Engine environments.

•

Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and testing solutions.

•

Demonstrated ability to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, integrations, and development environments.

•

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines and teams.

•

Comfortable owning tasks and asking for input when needed with a strong sense of curiosity toward solving technical challenges.

Nice to have:

•

Experience shipping an Unreal Engine-based game for Xbox or PlayStation consoles.

•

Prior experience with Unreal Engine, or a very strong understanding of Unreal from the development side, not limited to automated test work.

•

Experience with containerization and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, AWS, GCP).

•

Experience with programming and scripting skills using languages such as Python, TypeScript or C#.

•

Experience with performance profiling, debugging or validation tooling within Unreal Engine environments.

•

Experience with asset processing and validation pipelines, digital content authoring tools, or other proprietary game engine tools.

•

Experience supporting shared tooling, reusable systems, or cross-project technical initiatives.

•

Department Overview

The Right-of-Way Risk Reduction Strategy (ROWRS) team within Electric Transmission Engineering establishes a risk-based, technology-enabled approach to identify, prioritize, and resolve electric right-of-way encroachments and clearance issues. The team partners across Electric Operations, Land, Legal, Wildfire Risk, IT, Data and Analytics, and other functions to improve risk visibility, standardize processes, and support sustained reduction of right-of-way risk across PG&E’s service territory.

Position Summary

The Senior Data Engineer is the hands-on technical builder for the Right-of-Way Risk Reduction Strategy data ecosystem. This role designs, builds, and operates the data pipelines, system integrations, and reporting infrastructure that power ROWRS encroachment risk analytics and case management.

The role delivers the platform layer: ingesting and integrating data from Salesforce, SAP, Esri ArcGIS, LiDAR and remote-sensing sources, and other enterprise systems into Palantir Foundry; building and maintaining the transformation pipelines and curated data products the risk models consume.

This role works in close partnership with the ROWRS data science function, which defines the analytical methodology, risk model design, and the data requirements this role implements. The role is accountable for the technical delivery, reliability, performance, and maintainability of that platform.

The role will help transition ROW encroachment management from predominantly manual identification and case management toward a more proactive, technology-enabled, data-driven operating model. This includes identifying and evaluating opportunities to leverage GIS, LiDAR, spatial analytics, enterprise applications, data integration, automation, machine learning, and other emerging technologies to detect potential encroachments earlier, improve risk visibility, support risk-based prioritization, and enable more efficient remediation.

The position will partner with Electric Operations, Land & Environmental Management, Legal, Wildfire Risk, Asset Management, IT, and Data & Analytics teams to evaluate, pilot, and implement an integrated technology ecosystem that supports identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution of right-of-way encroachments and minimum clearance violations.

The role will provide technical leadership throughout the solution design, development, testing, implementation, and operationalization.

Business continuity, operational risk, data quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and enterprise technology standards will be incorporated into solution evaluation and implementation decisions.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned location at least twice a week and or based on business need.

PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.

Job Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Engineering & Operations (35%)

• Design, build, and operate PySpark transformation pipelines in Palantir Foundry across Raw, Clean, and Product layers
• Onboard and maintain source datasets from Salesforce, SAP, Esri ArcGIS, LiDAR and remote-sensing extracts, vegetation and inspection systems, outage and incident history, and work management.
• Implement joins, deduplication, key management, and slowly-changing-dimension handling against the documented data model.

• Instrument pipelines with data-quality checks, schema-drift detection, and structured logging; route unresolvable data gaps back to source-system owners through a defined exception process.
• Monitor scheduled builds, resolve failures, manage backfills, and maintain freshness and reliability SLAs.
• Optimize partitioning, incremental build strategy, and compute cost.

Reporting & BI Development Support (15%)

• Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards to specifications and metric definitions provided by the data science function and program stakeholders.
• Implement DAX measures, data model relationships, row-level security, incremental refresh, and gateway configuration.
• Produce and maintain star-schema fact and dimension datasets optimized for VertiPaq performance.

Testing, Implementation & Operationalization (10%)

This role and the ROWRS data science function operate as a paired delivery team. The data science function owns risk methodology, model design, feature and metric definitions, validation standards, and the analytical data requirements. This role owns the technical implementation: pipeline design and construction, system integration, platform operations, and reporting delivery. Technical implementation decisions rest with this role. Analytical methodology and data-requirement decisions rest with the data science function. Both roles jointly shape solution scope and sequencing with program leadership.
